## Legacy/public repository safety gate
- [ ] No secrets/customer data/private credentials
- [ ] Branding/entity/claims are current and approved
- [ ] Public content and dependencies reviewed
- [ ] IP/license status reviewed
- [ ] Privacy/security impact reviewed
- [ ] No production/customer use until current Commercial GO
- [ ] Final state: GO / HOLD / NO-GO

Unresolved P0 = **do not merge/deploy**.
